text.tspan: 1 · Capture transaction
Lock program revision guard, then offering guards in UUID order
Read policy, approved maps, grade revisions, roster + eligibility
Persist canonical immutable manifest + SHA-256 hash; commit
2 · Compute outside transaction
Normalized assessments → LO → CoursePO → StudentPO
Decimal precision 50; fixed ordering; no display rounding
Completeness + coverage + exclusion reasons
3 · Persist result transaction
Outcome rows + evidence edges + run COMPLETE
All-or-nothing; failure leaves no partial readable run
4 · Publish transaction
Reauthorize actor; lock same guards + publication series
Rebuild current manifest hash; check release + approval + completeness
Require expected series version + matching input hash
5 · Immutable publication
Insert publication + audit; advance series pointer; commit
Student reads only authorized publication and its frozen evidence
409 · Inputs or publication series changed
No publication inserted
Recalculate or refresh; existing publication stays readable
6 · Later correction
Same guard protocol; append GradeChange + bump revision
New run required; historical rows unchanged
Derived STALE badge
Compare live manifest to historical input hash
Original publication + evidence remain intact
